overweight.name: Overweight
beats: Moe walks in with his lunch kit.
Spots the truck scale. Curious.
Hops on. CLANK.
The needle swings deep into the red.
Glares at the dial.
Takes off his hard hat. Drops it. Still red.
Sets down his lunch kit. Still red.
Kicks off one boot. Then the other. Still red.
Sucks in his gut. Holds it. Still red.
Gives up. Turns and steps off in his socks.
Behind him, a magpie flies in and lands on the scale.
Ding. Green light.
Moe whips round. The magpie puffs up, smug.
Moe glares at the magpie. Then at you.
Turns and gathers his hat, kit and boots.
Stomps off in his socks.
The magpie hops round and flies off.
overweight.riddle: Spring roads can't take the weight. Neither can the scale.
overweight.hint: In Baldonnel, push a 3-cell rig into a road ban patch 3 times.

cranes.name: Two Left Feet
beats: A rattling call from above. Garooo.
Two sandhill cranes glide in, legs down.
They land. The second hop-turns to face the first.
They bow to each other.
The dance: leaps, half-open wings, more bows.
Slow Moe walks in from the far side and stops to watch.
He copies them. A bow. A flap. A little hop.
The cranes stop and stare at him.
He tries the one-leg pose, arms out like wings. Wobbles.
He notices them staring. Freezes. Sheepish grin.
Both cranes slowly shake their heads.
Crouch, leap, and they fly off.
A grey feather floats down onto his hat.
He puts his leg down. Looks at you. Shrugs.
Hop-turn. One last little flap. Walks off.
cranes.riddle: Something tall is dancing up there. Ask it down.
cranes.hint: In Baldonnel, tap the sky 3 times.

bison.name: Right of Way
beats: A bison ambles in from the left.
Stops in the middle of the lane.
Lies down. Chews.
Slow Moe drives in and stops.
BEEP BEEP.
The bison yawns. Does not move.
Clunk. Moe gets out on the far side.
Walks round the front of the truck to the bison.
Waves his arms. “Shoo!” The bison flicks its tail.
Claps. Clap clap. The bison keeps chewing.
He gives up. Arms drop.
Hop-turn. Stomps back round the front of the truck.
Clunk. Back in.
Backs up the way he came. Beep... beep... Grr.
The bison looks back...
...and giggles. Heh heh heh.
Gets up, in its own time.
Ambles off.
bison.riddle: That sign is not a suggestion.
bison.hint: In Baldonnel, tap the bison sign.

hare.name: Half Dressed
beats: A snowshoe hare hops in. Half brown, half white.
Sits by the snowbank. Nibbles.
Crunch crunch. Footsteps. Ears up.
Hides against the snow. His brown half sticks out. So does his white half.
Looks back at himself.
Hops onto the snowbank. The white half vanishes. The brown half does not.
Hop-turn down into the mud. Now the white half glows.
The footsteps are close.
Backs up to the line where snow meets mud. Gone. Just one eye.
The bearded worker strolls in, whistling.
Steps right over him.
The eye follows him out.
The hare reappears. Proud.
Hops off.
hare.riddle: Someone is changing behind the snowbank.
hare.hint: In Baldonnel, tap the snowbank 3 times.

ice.name: Last Ice
beats: Slow Moe drifts in on an ice pan, sitting on a pail, rod out.
The pan bumps into a chunk of ice and stops. Bump.
The bobber dips. Plunk.
He yanks. Up comes one tiny fish.
Holds it up. “Got one!”
Jumps up to celebrate.
The pan tips. Windmill arms.
Sits back down hard. SPLASH.
The fish flips out of his hand...
...and lands on the edge of the ice. Flip flop.
He leans out for it. Slowly. Carefully.
Bubbles.
A big pike bursts up out of the water...
...CHOMP. Gone.
And back down. SPLASH.
Moe, still reaching, looks at you.
The pan drifts back out the way it came.
ice.hint: In Baldonnel, tap the ice on the pond.

frogs.name: Late Croak
beats: The puddle ripples.
Blup. Blup. Blup. Three wood frogs pop up.
They sing in a round. Crick, crick, creek.
The bearded worker walks in.
Silence. Three frogs, frozen.
He stops. Looks down at the puddle. Hmm.
Shrugs. Walks on.
The little one lets out one late CREEK.
The other two turn and glare at him.
All three sink out of sight. Blup blup blup.
frogs.riddle: The puddle has a choir. One member is late.

mosquito.name: Lunch to Go
beats: Slow Moe walks in with his lunch kit.
Sets it down. Rubs his hands. Lunch time.
BZZZ. A big mosquito flies in...
...and lands on the lunch kit. Moe smirks.
It grabs the handle. Strains. bzzZZZ.
The lunch kit lifts off the ground.
Moe’s smirk drops.
It flies off with his lunch. “Hey!”
Moe chases after it.
mosquito.riddle: Soft ground, wet ground, hungry ground.
mosquito.hint: In Baldonnel, drive a pickup over a road ban patch 3 times.
